meta.pitch: Pay suppliers and contractors for the units they delivered and the buyer accepted, with a bonus for being on time and a retention that is released later.
meta.whoPays: A company that buys goods or work from many small suppliers or contractors
meta.signals: Units delivered and accepted (or an amount-based unit), deliveries on time, units rejected - from a goods-receipt record or a spreadsheet export
meta.idea: The supplier sees a payment as soon as the goods are accepted instead of waiting for the next payment run, and the buyer keeps a retention without chasing it.
meta.limits: The 10% retention is released on a DATE (30 days after the plan), not on approval: nobody approves it and the payer cannot cancel it once created. Releasing a retention when someone signs off needs an escrow, which is not part of this template. Harmony does not match purchase orders to invoices, judge quality, settle disputes or withhold taxes.

program.name: Supplier deliveries
program.description: A rate per point on accepted work, limited by a budget, with a retention released on a date.

metrics.label: Delivery on or before the agreed date
